description: The engine/Core 'brain' changes plus ALL the required cross-platform xUnit tests. Covers F2/F3 (ServiceItem slides are the single source of truth; GenerateSlidesFromSong is fallback only), F4 consumer test (section-loop reset), F5 test (chord transpose on pitch via GetStageText), F7 ClampDisplayIndex pure helper, F12 (SnapshotStageData under a lock), and the F8 result-mapping/defensive tests. These are unit-testable without WPF/ASP.NET and deliver the required test set named in the task. Depends on FEAT-001 (StageServerStartResult type) for the F8 mapping test; the F4 consumer test exercises the existing PresenterEngine.OnSectionLooped reset path (producer event comes from FEAT-002, final wiring in FEAT-004).
steps: F2/F3 in WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/PresenterEngine.cs LoadSong(Song song): capture `bool itemHasSlides = _serviceOrderManager.CurrentItem?.Slides?.Count > 0;` FIRST. Always set _currentSong = song; _pitchShiftSemitones = 0; _tempoPercent = 100.0; and fire SongLoaded (unchanged). Call GenerateSlidesFromSong(song) AND reset _currentSlideIndex ONLY when !itemHasSlides. When itemHasSlides, leave _currentSlides and _currentSlideIndex untouched and do NOT fire SlideChanged from LoadSong. In the fallback (!itemHasSlides) branch keep firing SlideChanged once for slide 0 as today. Keep GenerateSlidesFromSong intact for library/ChordPro songs that have sections[].text.

F12 in PresenterEngine.cs: add `private readonly object _stateLock = new();`. Add `public StageDisplayData SnapshotStageData()` that inside `lock (_stateLock)` reads _currentSlides, _currentSlideIndex, _currentSong (including _currentSong.Title and _currentSong.OriginalKey), _isLive, _isBlacked and builds and returns a brand-new StageDisplayData populated with all TEN values: CurrentText (current slide Content.Text), NextText (next slide Content.Text), SectionName (current slide SectionName), SongTitle, Key (= OriginalKey), OriginalKey, IsLive, IsBlacked, CurrentSlideIndex, TotalSlides. Null-guard every dereference (slide/Content/song may be null). Do not mutate the instance after the lock. Wrap the field WRITES in the SAME lock: SetSlideIndex (around the _currentSlideIndex write), GenerateSlidesFromSong (around the _currentSlides/_currentSlideIndex assignment), OnServiceItemChanged (around its _currentSlides/_currentSlideIndex assignment), and LoadSong's _currentSong assignment. Raise SlideChanged OUTSIDE the lock (compute args inside if needed, invoke after releasing).

F7 in WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/DisplayManager.cs: add `public static int ClampDisplayIndex(int savedIndex, int monitorCount)` — pure: if savedIndex < 0 return -1 (preserve unassigned); if monitorCount <= 0 return -1; if savedIndex >= monitorCount return -1; else return savedIndex. DisplayManager uses only WorshipPlayer.Core.Models so it is cross-platform.

Enable Tests to reach DisplayManager.ClampDisplayIndex: add `<Compile Include="..\WorshipPlayer.Presenter\Services\DisplayManager.cs" Link="DisplayManager.cs" />` to WorshipPlayer.Tests.csproj ONLY if the class cannot otherwise be referenced. Confirm the build stays at 0 new warnings; DisplayManager has no WPF/System.Windows dependency so this is safe. (If adding it introduces any new warning, instead make ClampDisplayIndex a tiny Core helper and have DisplayManager delegate.)

F2/F3 tests: WorshipPlayer.Tests/PresenterEngineSlideSourceTests.cs. Build a ServiceOrderManager (CreateNew + AddItem) with a Song ServiceItem carrying pre-baked slides (sectionName VERSE 1/CHORUS 1). Subscribe to engine.SlideChanged with a counter. Call engine.OnSongLoaded(emptyTextSong) and assert: engine.CurrentSlides are still the item slides (count + section names), AND LoadSong fired no additional SlideChanged (only the OnServiceItemChanged slide-0 emit counted). Second test: item with NO slides + a song whose Sections have Text -> fallback generation produces slides and SlideChanged fired once; assert generated slide SectionName matches the song section name OrdinalIgnoreCase.

F4 consumer test: WorshipPlayer.Tests/PresenterEngineLoopResetTests.cs. Set up slides across sections (e.g. VERSE 1 x2, CHORUS 1 x2). Advance into/within CHORUS 1, then call engine.OnSectionLooped("CHORUS 1") and assert CurrentSlideIndex is the FIRST CHORUS 1 slide (reset, not advance). Assert an unmatched name ("BRIDGE") causes no index change and no throw.

F5 test: WorshipPlayer.Tests/PresenterEngineTransposeTests.cs. Create a Slide with Content.Text containing "[C]". Assert engine.GetStageText(slide, 2) contains "[D]" (positive = up a tone) and engine.GetStageText(slide, 0) equals the original text unchanged.

F7 test: WorshipPlayer.Tests/ClampDisplayIndexTests.cs. Assert ClampDisplayIndex(1,1) == -1, ClampDisplayIndex(0,1) == 0, ClampDisplayIndex(-1,2) == -1, ClampDisplayIndex(1,2) == 1, ClampDisplayIndex(2,2) == -1.

F12 test: WorshipPlayer.Tests/PresenterEngineSnapshotTests.cs. Drive section-change -> loop -> position-update sequences and after each assert SnapshotStageData() is internally consistent: CurrentText and SectionName correspond to CurrentSlideIndex, and SongTitle/Key/OriginalKey reflect the loaded song; assert index is monotonic within a section. Plain lock, no UI thread.

F8 mapping test: WorshipPlayer.Tests/StageServerStartResultTests.cs. Using StageServerPortProbe (FEAT-001), occupy a port with a TcpListener and assert the mapping produces StageServerStartResult(Started:false, Error:non-empty); on a free ephemeral port assert StageServerStartResult(Started:true, Error:null). (This is the host-free portion of F8 (c); the live single-arg StartAsync no-NRE check is covered by FEAT-004 build + human-on-hardware.)

Defensive (F9/F10) engine test: WorshipPlayer.Tests/DefensiveLoadTests.cs. (a) ServiceOrderManager.LoadAsync on a temp file containing malformed JSON returns null and does not throw. (b) A Song with null/empty Sections and Tracks fed through engine.OnSongLoaded (fallback path) and SnapshotStageData() does not throw NRE.
acceptance_criteria: LoadSong keeps populated ServiceItem slides and fires no duplicate SlideChanged in the item-slides case; still generates+fires once in the fallback case.
PresenterEngine.OnSectionLooped resets to the section's first slide; unmatched name is a no-op without throwing.
GetStageText(slide,+2) transposes [C]->[D]; GetStageText(slide,0) returns text unchanged.
ClampDisplayIndex behaves per the table (out-of-range -> -1, in-range preserved, -1 preserved).
SnapshotStageData returns an internally consistent fresh instance built under _stateLock; all mutating writers take the same lock; SlideChanged is raised outside the lock.
All new xUnit tests pass and the full suite stays green with no new warnings.
verification: dotnet build WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln --nologo (0 errors, no new warnings beyond the 4 pre-existing)
dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests --nologo (all green: 411 baseline + the new tests)
findings: ENGINE CHANGES (WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/PresenterEngine.cs): (1) Added `private readonly object _stateLock = new();`. (2) F2/F3 LoadSong(Song song): now captures `bool itemHasSlides = _serviceOrderManager.CurrentItem?.Slides?.Count > 0;` FIRST; always sets _currentSong (under _stateLock), _pitchShiftSemitones=0, _tempoPercent=100.0 and fires SongLoaded; calls GenerateSlidesFromSong + fires one slide-0 SlideChanged ONLY when !itemHasSlides; when itemHasSlides it leaves _currentSlides/_currentSlideIndex untouched and fires NO SlideChanged. (3) F12 added `public StageDisplayData SnapshotStageData()` — reads all state inside `lock(_stateLock)`, null-guards slide/Content/song, returns a brand-new StageDisplayData with the TEN values (CurrentText, NextText, SectionName, SongTitle, Key=OriginalKey, OriginalKey, IsLive, IsBlacked, CurrentSlideIndex, TotalSlides). (4) Field WRITES wrapped in the same _stateLock: LoadSong (_currentSong), GenerateSlidesFromSong (builds into a local list then assigns _currentSlides/_currentSlideIndex under lock; also null-guards song.Sections), OnServiceItemChanged (_currentSlides/_currentSlideIndex, null-coalesces Slides to new list), SetSlideIndex (index write). SlideChanged is always raised OUTSIDE the lock. No public engine signature changed except the ADDED `StageDisplayData SnapshotStageData()`. DISPLAYMANAGER (WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/DisplayManager.cs): added `public static int ClampDisplayIndex(int savedIndex, int monitorCount)` (pure: savedIndex<0 => -1; monitorCount<=0 => -1; savedIndex>=monitorCount => -1; else savedIndex). TESTS CSPROJ: added `<Compile Include="..\WorshipPlayer.Presenter\Services\DisplayManager.cs" Link="DisplayManager.cs" />` (no new warnings; DisplayManager is Core-models-only). NEW TEST FILES in WorshipPlayer.Tests/: PresenterEngineSlideSourceTests.cs (2), PresenterEngineLoopResetTests.cs (2), PresenterEngineTransposeTests.cs (2), ClampDisplayIndexTests.cs (1 Theory, 5 cases), PresenterEngineSnapshotTests.cs (2), StageServerStartResultTests.cs (2), DefensiveLoadTests.cs (2) = 17 new tests, all pass. TEST-SETUP NOTE for later features: ServiceOrderManager.AddItem fires ItemChanged only for the FIRST item, so the PresenterEngine must be constructed BEFORE AddItem for its OnServiceItemChanged handler to load the item slides. VERIFICATION: `dotnet build WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln --nologo` = 0 errors, exactly the 4 pre-existing warnings (no new). `dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests --nologo` = all 17 new tests + the rest green; the ONLY failures are the 15 pre-existing host-specific BibleDatabaseServiceTests SQLite teardown flakes documented in FEAT-001 (reproduce in isolation with none of my files involved) — unrelated to FEAT-003.
